description: Bounded-incompleteness registry. Planned artifacts are not completed controls, do not authorize external action, and must not be represented as deployed capability.

artifacts.purpose: Define a rights-centered, uncertainty-aware protocol for any future site-specific TTF calibration.
required_before: Any claim of site-specific TTF calibration.
Any use of primary site measurements for TTF calibration.
Any rights-holder-directed monitoring extension involving site-specific TTF values.

artifacts.purpose: Define local baseline-panel requirements, community-type classification, robust normalization, constrained weight estimation, threshold calibration, and independent ecological review for BRI use outside the original calibration region.
required_before: Any claim that BRI is calibrated or applicable in a new region.
Any publication comparing BRI health categories across separately calibrated regions.
Any use of region-specific BRI values for decision support.
